commands.cmd:
V="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/promotion-gate-20260922/.venv"
sync=$(timeout 60 uv pip sync --dry-run --offline --python "$V/bin/python3" blueprints/us-equities/data/requirements.lock 2>&1) || { echo "PANDERA_INSTALL_FAIL: uv pip sync --dry-run failed"; printf '%s\n' "$sync" | tail -5; exit 1; }
pv=$("$V/bin/python3" -s -c "import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version('pandera'))") || { echo "PANDERA_INSTALL_FAIL: pandera not importable metadata"; exit 1; }
tag=$(timeout 30 git ls-remote https://github.com/unionai-oss/pandera 'refs/tags/v0.33.1' 'refs/tags/v0.33.1^{}' | awk '{print $1}' | tail -1)
python3 - "$sync" "$pv" "$tag" <<'PY'
import glob, json, re, sys
sync, pv, tag = sys.argv[1:4]
pins = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == 'data-pandera'})
commits = {c for p in pins for c in re.findall(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', p)}
lock = open('blueprints/us-equities/data/requirements.lock').read()
locked = re.findall(r'^pandera==(\S+)', lock, re.M)
unchanged = 'Would make no changes' in sync
ok = len(commits) == 1 and tag in commits and pv == '0.33.1' and locked == ['0.33.1'] and unchanged
print('PANDERA_INSTALL_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| winner pin', pins, '| upstream tag v0.33.1 ->', tag, '| promotion-gate venv pandera', pv, '| requirements.lock pandera', locked, '| uv pip sync --dry-run --offline against the hash-pinned lock:', sync.strip().splitlines()[-1])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

commands.cmd:
V="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/promotion-gate-20260922/.venv"
PIN=62f55e2dccf0a199cfe4d6ce3eda0c1d29e2e4e6
OMIT="test_docs_setting_column_widths.py test_multithreaded.py test_pandas_engine.py test_pandas_parallel.py"
D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
timeout 120 git clone -q --depth 1 --branch v0.33.1 https://github.com/unionai-oss/pandera "$D/src" > "$D/clone.log" 2>&1 || { echo "PANDERA_COLLECTION_FAIL: clone of v0.33.1 failed"; exit 1; }
head=$(git -C "$D/src" rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$head" = "$PIN" ] || { echo "PANDERA_COLLECTION_FAIL: v0.33.1 checkout $head is not the winner pin commit"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$D/run" && cp -a "$D/src/tests" "$D/src/pyproject.toml" "$D/run/" || exit 1
cd "$D/run" || exit 1
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 timeout 600 uv run -q --no-project --python "$V/bin/python3" --with pytest==9.1.1 --with hypothesis==6.168.1 -- python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider --collect-only -q tests/pandas > "$D/collect.log" 2>&1
rc=$?
python3 - "$D" "$rc" "$OMIT" <<'PY'
import glob, os, re, sys
d, rc, omit = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sorted(sys.argv[3].split())
lines = open(d + '/collect.log').read().splitlines()
test_files = sorted(os.path.relpath(p, d + '/run') for p in glob.glob(d + '/run/tests/pandas/test_*.py'))
collected = sorted({l.split('::', 1)[0] for l in lines if l.startswith('tests/pandas/') and '::' in l})
errors, current = {}, None
for l in lines:
    m = re.match(r'^_+ ERROR collecting (tests/pandas/\S+\.py) _+$', l)
    if m:
        current = os.path.basename(m.group(1))
        errors[current] = None
        continue
    if current and errors[current] is None:
        m = re.match(r"^E\s+ModuleNotFoundError: No module named '([^']+)'", l)
        if m:
            errors[current] = m.group(1)
summary = [l.strip('= ') for l in lines if re.search(r'\d+ tests? collected', l)]
ok = (rc == 2 and bool(summary) and sorted(errors) == omit and all(errors.values())
      and len(test_files) == len(collected) + len(errors))
print('PANDERA_COLLECTION_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| collect-only, all', len(test_files), 'tests/pandas test files: exit', rc, '|', summary[-1] if summary else 'no summary', '|', len(collected), 'files collect | missing module per non-importing file:', errors, '| == the files commands 3 and 4 omit:', sorted(errors) == omit)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

timeout 120 git clone -q --depth 1 --branch v0.33.1 https://github.com/unionai-oss/pandera "$D/src" > "$D/clone.log" 2>&1 || { echo "PANDERA_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: clone of v0.33.1 failed"; exit 1; }
head=$(git -C "$D/src" rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$head" = "$PIN" ] || { echo "PANDERA_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: v0.33.1 checkout $head is not the winner pin commit"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$D/run" && cp -a "$D/src/tests" "$D/src/pyproject.toml" "$D/run/" || exit 1
cd "$D/run" || exit 1

PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 timeout 900 uv run -q --no-project --python "$V/bin/python3" --with pytest==9.1.1 --with hypothesis==6.168.1 -- python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -rs tests/pandas $(for f in $OMIT; do printf '%s ' "--ignore=tests/pandas/$f"; done) > "$D/pytest.log" 2>&1
rc=$?
python3 - "$D" "$rc" "$V" "$head" "$OMIT" <<'PY'
import collections, re, sys
d, rc, venv, head, omit = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5].split()
where = open(d + '/where.txt').read().split('\n')
log = open(d + '/pytest.log').read()
summary = [line for line in log.splitlines() if re.match(r'^=+ .* in [0-9.]+s', line)]
counts = {k: int(n) for n, k in re.findall(r'(\d+) (passed|failed|errors?|skipped|xfailed|xpassed|deselected)', summary[-1] if summary else '')}
config = [line.replace(d, '<tmp>') for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith(('platform ', 'configfile:', 'collected '))]
from_venv = where[0].startswith(venv + '/lib/') and '/site-packages/pandera/' in where[0]
configfile = [line.split(':', 1)[1].strip() for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith('configfile:')]
skips = collections.Counter()
for m in re.finditer(r'^SKIPPED \[(\d+)\] [^:]+:\d+: (.*)$', log, re.M):
    skips[m.group(2)] += int(m.group(1))
ok = rc == 0 and bool(summary) and counts.get('passed', 0) > 0 and counts.get('failed', 0) == 0 and counts.get('error', 0) == 0 and counts.get('errors', 0) == 0 and from_venv and where[1].split()[0] == '0.33.1' and configfile == ['pyproject.toml']
print('PANDERA_UPSTREAM_TESTS_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| upstream tests/pandas except', len(omit), 'files: pytest exit', rc, '|', summary[-1].strip('= ') if summary else 'no summary', '| configfile', configfile, '| v0.33.1 checkout', head, '| pandera from the promotion-gate venv:', from_venv)
print('skip reasons:', dict(skips), '|', ' | '.join(config), '| pandera/pytest/hypothesis', where[1])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

The promotion-gate environment reports pandera 0.33.1, and uv pip sync --dry-run --offline would make no changes against the hash-pinned blueprints/us-equities/data/requirements.lock. The upstream tag unionai-oss/pandera v0.33.1 resolves to the winner pin commit 62f55e2dccf0a199cfe4d6ce3eda0c1d29e2e4e6. From a shallow clone at that commit, pytest --collect-only over all 36 test files of upstream's tests/pandas collects 32; the other 4 do not import in this environment (test_docs_setting_column_widths.py needs upstream's docs package, test_multithreaded.py and test_pandas_parallel.py need joblib, test_pandas_engine.py needs pytz).
